author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: domed head with rounded floppy ears, two jowl lobes meeting at a central notch under a nose bar with its stem, and neck lines falling from the ear tips to the bottom corners; mirrored about x=24. The rejected drawing was an arch with a small muzzle and no ears or jowls.
omissions: The reference's separate inner ear strokes are merged into the ear tips (jowls and neck leave from the ear tip) because a separate stroke would sit closer than 8 units; the rounded nose outline becomes a round-capped bar.
drawing_plan: Mirrored about x=24: head cubic run over ears and crown, jowl cubics to notch (24,33), neck cubics to (6,42)/(42,42), nose bar with stem.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'dog': head silhouette from few cubic runs, ears as rounded lobes.
